excitation_backprop: run excitation backprop to compute a saliency map for a given model and input tensor
contrastive_excitation_backprop: compute a contrastive excitation backprop saliency map by contrasting target class against all others
ExcitationBackpropContext: use the ExcitationBackpropContext context manager to patch conv, pool, and norm layers for EBP backprop
eltwise_sum: create an element-wise sum operation to replace skip connections in ResNet models for EBP compatibility
update_resnet: update a ResNet model to use EltwiseSum for skip connections so it works with excitation backprop
